# lev-tech.net

> אחסון אתרים מנוהל, אחסון WooCommerce, שרתי VPS ושירותי IT מקצועיים – ביצועים, אבטחה ותמיכה בעברית

Generated for LLMs and search engines to help index the site and understand its primary pages.

This repository enables crawling and indexing by major AI crawlers and search engines. The website's robots.txt explicitly allows OpenAI's crawlers (GPTBot, OAI-SearchBot), Google (Googlebot, GoogleOther), and Bing (Bingbot).

Sitemap: https://lev-tech.net/sitemap.xml

Primary pages:
- https://lev-tech.net/ — דף הבית: אחסון אתרים מנוהל, אחסון WooCommerce, שרתי VPS ושירותי IT מקצועיים.
- https://lev-tech.net/index.html — דף הבית (קובץ סטטי).

Notes:
- The repository includes automation scripts (scripts/update_cidrs.sh) to fetch provider cidr lists for firewall allow-lists. These files require manual review before applying to production firewalls.
- Ensure the robots.txt and sitemap.xml files are served from the root of the production domain (https://lev-tech.net/robots.txt and /sitemap.xml) so crawlers can discover them.
